web_events.answer: China's official manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 50.3 in June 2026, indicating an expansion in the manufacturing sector. This growth was driven by robust tech export demand and a recovery in overseas orders, despite challenges from global uncertainties.
